## Compliance Items

Complete each item before the tool proceeds to deployment (Phase 7).

| # | Requirement | Status | Notes |
|---|-------------|--------|-------|
| 1 | Data classification completed (CUI, PII, PHI determination) |  |  |
| 2 | PIA threshold analysis completed (use pia-threshold-analysis.md) |  |  |
| 3 | Privacy Officer consulted (if PII is involved) |  |  |
| 4 | SORN requirements reviewed (if PII is retrieved by identifier) |  |  |
| 5 | ATO status verified (if tool is a new information system) |  |  |
| 6 | OPSEC review completed (no sensitive indicators in tool outputs) |  |  |
| 7 | Records management requirements identified (retention schedule) |  |  |
| 8 | Incident response procedures documented |  |  |
| 9 | Access controls implemented (authentication, RBAC) |  |  |
| 10 | Audit logging enabled |  |  |
| 11 | Input validation implemented |  |  |
| 12 | Data encryption verified (at rest and in transit) |  |  |
| 13 | Tool registered in Tool Registry (use tool-registry-entry.md) |  |  |

## Approval

- [ ] All items complete — tool may proceed to deployment
- [ ] Items outstanding — tool must not deploy until resolved
